title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
abstract: arXiv:2609.40356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. translated_title: ViTEX-Bench：面向高保真视频场景文本编辑的基准测试
translated_abstract: 近年来，视频生成技术日益逼真且可控，但视频编辑的发展仍相对滞后，尤其是那些必须保留原始场景动态的精确局部编辑。视频场景文本编辑旨在替换场景表面上的文字（如店面招牌、白板和产品标签），同时保留周围内容、运动和相机动态。尽管图像领域的场景文本编辑已被充分研究，但能够实现高视觉质量、时间一致性和编辑局部性的视频场景文本编辑仍缺乏深入探索。现有资源提供的成对真实视频数据有限，且通用的视频编辑指标无法直接衡量所请求的文本随时间是否保持正确。我们提出了 ViTEX-Bench，这是一个由 ViTEX-Dataset 数据集和三轴评估协议组成的基准测试套件。该数据集包含 387 段带有文本区域掩码和编辑指令的真实世界 720p 视频：其中 230 段提供了…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了 ViTEX-Bench，首个针对高保真视频场景文本编辑的基准套件，包含 387 段真实视频组成的数据集与三轴评估协议，用以衡量文本编辑的视觉质量、时间一致性和编辑局部性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ViTEX-Bench, the first benchmark suite for high-fidelity video scene text editing, consisting of a dataset of 387 real-world 720p videos and a three-axis evaluation protocol that measures visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality.
